# Adaptive approach to delay-aware portfolio allocation

A concept shared by **5** of the 14,225 algorithms in the [ranked algorithm list](../../algorithm_ledger.md#8c-the-ranked-algorithm-list-csv-import) (CSV import of 2026-10-27); its best-ranked member is #8,480. ## Description

Proposed adaptive approach to delay-aware portfolio allocation: Model delayed or lagged relationships in market variables and use the estimated dynamics to adjust portfolio weights; the state equations and decision rules require specification. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
